from kfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from kfx.io import BoolInput, MessageTextInput, Output
from kfx.schema.message import Message

class ChatInput(Component):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    inputs = [MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input"), BoolInput(name="should_store_message", display_name="Store", value=False)]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response")]
    async def message_response(self):
        return Message(text=str(self.input_value))

from kfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from kfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from kfx.schema.message import Message

class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Prompt Template"
    inputs = [MessageTextInput(name="template", display_name="Template")]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt")]
    async def build_prompt(self):
        return Message(text=str(self.template))

from kfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from kfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from kfx.schema.message import Message

class LanguageModelComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Language Model"
    inputs = [MessageTextInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input"), MessageTextInput(name="system_message", display_name="System"), MessageTextInput(name="api_key", display_name="API Key")]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="build_message")]
    async def build_message(self):
        return Message(text=str(self.input_value))
